title: No notifications !!
body: The design is cute and it is easy to use, but there are no NOTIFICATIONS. That is the point of an app like this, having reminders. The app doesn’t appear on the phone’s list Notifications. I tried uninstalling and reinstalling multiple times. I am very disappointed. I do not recommend.

title: Beautiful UI but lacking features
body:
I really wanted to get the lifetime subscription, but I realized 
1. there's no way to even set the time at which your dailies reset. My day does not start or end at 12am. 
2. There's also no widget. 
3. It would be PERFECT if there was a desktop version that was synced with mobile. 

I am going to hold off on subscribing until at least the first feature is met... Come on guys, this is basic stuff for a habit app. I track my water usage past midnight and it doesn't reset after I sleep?? 

I hope I know when this is implemented so I can subscribe.
